start: Admin app, Add member (or a member's page)

steps.action: Take a photo with the computer's camera, or pick a picture file
user_sees: A small square photo, the same as the camera preview
must_not: The photo flipped after 'Take photo'
A big file sent as it is

steps.action: Save
user_sees: The photo on the member's page, member card and check-in screen
must_not: Another member's or another gym's photo shown
The member saved without the photo and no word

start: Admin app, a member's page

steps.action: Save a picture that is not a JPEG, or over 100,000 bytes
user_sees: Refused: BAD_PHOTO or TOO_BIG (app words unknown)
must_not: A broken picture saved

steps.action: Save a photo for someone not on the gym's list
user_sees: Refused: NO_MEMBER
must_not: A photo saved for a member of another gym

start: A member with a photo

steps.action: 'Change photo', take a new one
user_sees: The new photo replaces the old one everywhere
must_not: Two photos for one member
The old photo shown on the check-in screen

steps.action: Remove the photo
user_sees: Initials in place of the photo
must_not: The photo still shown after removing it

start: A member with a photo

steps.action: Anyone outside the gym, or the member app, tries to get the photo
user_sees: Nothing: the photo has no link and is read only through the gym's own key
must_not: A public or shareable link to the photo
Another gym's key reading it

steps.action: A staff person is removed
user_sees: Their session stops at once and can no longer read photos
must_not: A removed person still loading photos
